+# Artigo 168.º - despesas adicionais em teletrabalho
+
+DR consolidated source, article 168 of the Código do Trabalho.
+
+Relevant extracted rule:
+
+- The individual employment contract and the applicable collective labour regulation instrument must fix, when the telework agreement is made, the compensation owed to the worker for additional expenses.
+- If the parties have not agreed on a fixed amount, additional expenses are:
+  - acquisition of goods and/or services that the worker did not have before the telework agreement referred to in article 166; and
+  - expenses determined by comparison with the worker's homologous expenses in the last month of in-person work.
+
+Use this extract for rule lookups on what counts as additional expenses when no fixed amount was set for telework compensation.

+
+DR consolidated source, article 166.º-A of the Código do Trabalho.
+
+Relevant extracted rule:
+
+- A worker recognised as a non-primary informal caregiver has a right to work under telework for a maximum period of four years, consecutive or interpolated, upon proof of that status under applicable law.

+DR consolidated source, article 442 of the Código Civil.
+
+Relevant extracted rule:
+
+- When there is sinal, the thing delivered is imputed to the performance due, or returned when imputation is not possible.
+- If the party who constituted the sinal fails to perform the obligation for a cause imputable to that party, the other contracting party may keep the thing delivered.
+- If non-performance is due to the other contracting party, the party who constituted the sinal may demand double what was provided.
+- Where there has been delivery of the thing to which the promised contract refers, article 442(2) also provides an alternative value-based remedy, but the base sinal consequence remains loss of the sinal or payment of double the sinal.
+- In either article 442(2) case, the non-defaulting party may alternatively request specific performance under article 830.
+- Unless otherwise stipulated, there is no further indemnity for non-performance in cases of loss of sinal, payment of double sinal, or the value-based remedy.
+

+# Artigo 877.º - venda a filhos ou netos
+
+DR consolidated source, article 877 of the Código Civil.
+
+Relevant extracted rule:
+
+- Parents and grandparents may not sell to children or grandchildren if the other children or grandchildren do not consent to the sale.
+- If consent cannot be given or is refused, the descendants' consent may be judicially supplied.
+- A sale made in breach of that consent rule is voidable.
+- Annulment may be requested by the children or grandchildren who did not give consent.
+- The annulment request must be made within one year from knowledge of the contract's conclusion, or from the end of incapacity if they are incapable.
+- The prohibition does not cover dação em cumprimento made by the ascendant.
+
+Use this extract for statute-first rule lookups on sales by parents or grandparents to descendants where other descendants exist.
